narr: A low pressure system spinning over northern Louisiana and southern Arkansas brought several rounds of showers and thunderstorms producing widespread heavy rain to northeast Louisiana through the day August 24th.
ev: Multiple roads were covered with water in northern Franklin Parish.
Flood water entered several homes off of Highway 8.
